up: Retrieve all molecule_chembl_id values for compounds that are documented in the document with the ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL5729049.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_chembl_id
FROM activities a
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729049';

up: Retrieve the list of molecules (molecule_chembl_id) associated with the document whose ChEMBL identifier is CHEMBL5729049, ensuring each molecule appears only once in the result set.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.molecule_chembl_id
FROM activities a
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729049';
